excerpts.content:
New [tests-zkevm@v21.0.0](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-zkevm%40v21.0.0), related to upcoming Glamsterdam update on sepolia.
Apart from spec related changes from the base `execution-spec` release, it also adds a tighter check on SSZ malformed inputs.
See the PR description for more info.

excerpts.author: 0xrubo
excerpts.content: <@774033563732541451> we just [fixed a bug](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/13785) in our guest. the side effect is that *the pub key hint no longer saves anything* for us. the spec allows skipping recovery only if the key is also checked against the y-parity. recover-and-compare is the only compliant option, and it costs the same as not having the keys. happy to be corrected if i'm missing another way to use the keys.
